asset_heavy.reason: Owns and operates a fleet of modern VLGC ships worth tens of millions each; fleet renewal needs heavy capital.

big_ticket.reason: Charters and freight shipments are repeated transport services, not one-off large purchases of goods.

cyclical_demand.reason: LPG used for cooking, heating, and industry; shipping demand is fairly steady, though charter rates fluctuate.

large_customers.reason: Charterers are major oil companies, LPG traders and distributors, which are large enterprises.

notes: Recurring and cyclical answers are judgement calls, as charter rates are volatile and some work is spot.

offers_products.reason: Sells LPG transportation, not goods; the LPG belongs to charterers.

offers_services.reason: Provides seaborne LPG transportation through time, spot and bareboat charters on its VLGC fleet.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes mainly from owned VLGC vessels; crew operate the ships, but the assets drive the service.

recurring_revenue.reason: Revenue comes from time charters and repeat long-standing customers, including the Helios Pool, though some spot.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are charterers such as oil majors, traders and distributors, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Charters VLGCs to oil majors, LPG traders and distributors.
